latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator Image – Generate Captions from Images.

- Instantly generate and overlay AI captions on your uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF up to 200MB).
- Download captioned image videos as 1080p MP4, optimized for social media.
- Automatic session creation and backend connection with free credits for new users.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows with timeline state tracking.
- Clear error handling for common issues (file size, format, credits, etc.).
- Rapid cloud rendering pipeline (20–90s per job) with plain, actionable user prompts.
